# staticform_email_domain (Resource)

A managed sending domain (Amazon SES). Publish the returned DKIM records in DNS to verify it. Verification is asynchronous: apply does not block on it; the `status` attribute reflects the latest state on refresh.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "staticform_email_domain" "example" {
  domain_name = "example.com"
}

# Publish these DKIM records in DNS to verify the domain.
output "dkim_records" {
  value = staticform_email_domain.example.dkim_records
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String) Domain to send from, e.g. `example.com`.

### Optional

- `mail_from_subdomain` (String) MAIL FROM subdomain label (defaults to `bounces`). Empty string skips MAIL FROM configuration.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `dkim_records` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dkim_records))
- `dmarc_status` (String) `Unchecked`, `Found`, `Missing`, or `LookupFailed`.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mail_from_domain` (String)
- `mail_from_records` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mail_from_records))
- `status` (String) `NotStarted`, `Pending`, `Verified`, `Failed`, or `TemporaryFailure`.
- `suggested_dmarc_record` (String)
